note: Bayfield County Forestry & Parks campground on Delta Lake, 62020 Delta Park Rd (7 mi S of Iron River then 6 mi E on Scenic Dr). Wooded sites back from the shore; boat launch, fishing piers, swimming beach and a CAMBA trailhead. Some sites are let to seasonal campers. --Claude
summary: County page, 2025 rules PDF, 2025 site map and imagery read. Fees corrected: base $25 non-electric (stored $35), high $35, $5 extra person over 6; 16-day max stay; no water hookups; 34 sites, showers, pit toilets, dump, water, WiFi confirmed. Not waterfront confirmed. Stored 50-amp and 36-ft max have no current source. Phone order differs. No season stated.
flags: PHONE: stored 715-372-8610 -> 715-209-8423 (the county page lists 715-209-8423 first, 'contacts listed in order of preference', and the rules PDF names it as the campground manager's line; 715-372-8610 is the second number).

UNSOURCED: hookups.electric 50 and sites.max_rig_ft 36 (derived from note prose citing a site map with 'max camper sizes 30-36 ft' and '20/30/50-amp'). The current 2025 county map shows no lengths or amperages and marks every site electric; no page read gives amps or lengths. Left in place; the note's claims removed.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. Imagery shows the sites under continuous canopy back from Delta Lake; the east shore is reed marsh, and the nearest sites to open water (2 by the launch, 13-16 east) are behind trees.

Seasonal share not measured: the page posts a $2,000 seasonal electric rate and the rules have a seasonal-campers section, but daily and weekly rates and reservations are offered and it is a county campground; no site-by-site split is published.
Season not stated on any county page read.
